body: # U.S. Economy Overview at a Glance. ## Uploaded by. AI-enhanced title and description. The document provides a summary of key economic indicators for the United States as of April 2025, including unemployment rates, payroll employment changes, average hourly earnings, and price indices. It highlights monthly and quarterly data trends, such as a slight increase in the unemployment rate and fluctuations in consumer and producer price indices. The data is sourced from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics and includes both preliminary and revised figures. ## Share this document. ## Footer menu. ## Support. ## Legal. ## Social. ## Get our free apps. The Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) produces Economy at a Glance pages at the national, regional, state, and metropolitan area levels. * Data at the  **regional** level are produced by the following programs: Local Area Unemployment Statistics, Consumer Price Index, and Employment Cost Index. * Data at the **State** level are produced by the following programs: Local Area Unemployment Statistics, State and Area portion of and Current Employment Statistics. * Data at the  **metropolitan** area level are produced by the following programs: Local Area Unemployment Statistics, the State and Area portion of Current Employment Statistics, and, for some metropolitan areas, the Consumer Price Index. At the higher aggregation levels (national, regional, and state) the data are typically seasonally adjusted. At the metropolitan area level the data are typically not seasonally adjusted. | **Current Employment Statistics** | Seasonally  Adjusted |  | Seasonally  Adjusted | Not  Seasonally  Adjusted |. | **Local Area Unemployment Statistics** |  | Seasonally  Adjusted | Seasonally  Adjusted | Not  Seasonally  Adjusted |.
